name: move_sneak_stance_edge
about: Sneaking in place, at a platform edge and on a slab rim: the 1.7.10 eye/stance drop (ySize 0.2 x 0.4 per move) and its decay after release vs 1.8.9's instant 1.54 eye; the sneak edge guard; a sneaking jump onto the slab rim (1.7.10's step gate while sneaking in the air).

steps.note: sneak-walk up onto the slab rim and hold at its edge
unsneak at the edge: walk off
back on top: jump toward the rim holding sneak and W
